g.text: 1. 16-48 V in, 12 V / 8 A out, 400 kHz. Predicted efficiency 96.4 % at 24 V, 8 A (calc/buck_calc.md).

g.text: 2. Type-III voltage-mode loop: fc ~ 43 kHz, phase margin ~ 80 deg (model).

g.text: 3. Hot loop = C2-C6 -> Q1 -> Q2 -> GND. Keep it on L1/L2 with GND (In1) directly under.
